chapters.title: FORMING
chapters.text: The cash open starts a fresh session VWAP at 26,014.75. It raises no state and no event for its first 15 bars while the anchor forms.

chapters.title: EXTENDED
chapters.text: A second close beyond the session's 90% edge (26,071.00) confirms it: 26,074.50 is +53.50 from the session VWAP, 2.1σ. The RETURN chip reads 86% over 60 bars · HOT.

chapters.title: BACK IN VALUE
chapters.text: The close 26,121.00 came back inside the session's 50% core (26,125.25), which ends the extension above. The session VWAP stands at 26,065.25.

chapters.title: AT VWAP
chapters.text: The first bar since the extension above to trade at the session VWAP 26,072.25 (low 26,070.50). The tool rings it on the SESSION strip and clears the extension.
